_how_to_edit: Rainy talks with the visitor in an RPG-style dialogue. 'dialogue' holds named parts of the conversation; it always starts at 'intro'. Each line has a pose (wave, surprised, sassy, dance, thinking, curtsy, walk, eat, sit, play, sleep) and text. A line can end with 'choices' (the visitor's possible replies); each choice says which part to go to next ('end' closes the dialogue). A line can also have 'goto' to jump to another part after it. 'tips' are what Rainy says when someone clicks her later; 'spots' are where she wanders (x/y = % of the painting where her feet go).
name: Rainy

tips.text: Psst… have you cracked a fortune cookie yet?
The cocktails are the wildest page. Proof 91? Sunny really did that.
Sign the guest book at the empty chair. Sunny reads every note.
Want the serious version of Sunny? Flip the egg and read her tasting menu.
The noodle bowl is where her story starts.

intro.text: Oh! A visitor! Welcome to Sunny's personal website.
You actually made it all the way here? Most people get lost at the front door.

found.text: Ooh, confident. Sunny would like you already.

lost.text: Don't worry — everyone's a little lost in Wonderland. That's half the fun.

about.text: I'm Rainy. I look after this little corner of Wonderland while Sunny is off doing something crazy.
She says yes to anything new… and then cooks dinner for everyone afterwards.
So tell me — what kind of visitor are you?

choices.label: I'm here for the fun stuff.

fun.text: My favorite answer! Every dish on that table hides a piece of her story.
So… are you ready to figure out something fun about her?

work.text: Ah, a serious one! Flip the egg in the middle of the table — her proper, daytime side has a tasting menu with her résumé.
But between you and me… the fun side is better. Ready to look around?

choices.label: Fine, show me the fun side.

help.text: Click any dish on the table and its page opens in the recipe book.
The egg in the middle flips between Sunny's two worlds. Catch the treasures while you fall down the rabbit hole!
Your journal is at the top left — it keeps track of everything you find. Now go on, the tea's getting cold!
